title: Kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside exerts cardioprotective effects through NF-kappaB/NLRP3/Caspase-1 pathway in ventricular remodeling after acute myocardial infarction.
authors: Hua, Fang; Li, Jing Ya; Zhang, Meng; Zhou, Peng; Wang, Liang; Ling, Tie Jun; Bao, Guan Hu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷通过NF-kappaB/NLRP3/Caspase-1通路改善心梗后心室重构，仅用分子对接预测药物与蛋白结合，核心是药物-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题关联极弱。
abstract: Ventricular remodeling (VR) after acute myocardial infarction (AMI) is the main pathogenesis of chronic heart failure (CHF). Kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside (KR) is the flavonoid glycoside with the highest content in Lu'an GuaPian tea, which has good pharmacological activities. However, the mechanism of KR against VR after AMI remains unclear. Molecular docking was used to predict the targets of KR on the NLRP3/Caspase-1 signaling pathway. Histological changes in the myocardium were visualized using HE staining, Masson staining. Cardiomyocyte apoptosis was detected using TUNEL. Immunohistochemistry was used to examine NLRP3, Caspase-1 p20, and GSDMD. IL-1beta level in serum was detected using ELISA. Finally, the expressions of NF-kappaB p65, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1 p20, GSDMD, and IL-1beta were measured using RT-PCR and Western blotting. Our results showed that KR had a good binding activity with NLRP3, Caspase-1, and GSDMD, significantly improved cardiac function, alleviated cardiac pathological changes, reduced the excessive deposition of myocardial interstitial collagen, and inhibited cardiomyocyte apoptosis in AMI rats. Furthermore, KR could decrease the IL-1beta level and inhibit the expressions of NF-kappaB p65, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1 p20, GSDMD, and IL-1beta. Our study suggests that KR can prevent and treat VR after AMI, and the protective effect is related to its regulatory NF-kappaB/NLRP3/Caspase-1 signaling pathway. PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS: Kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside is present in Carthamus tinctorius L., Nymphaea candida, Afgekia mahidoliae and green tea, which has good pharmacological activities against liver injury, cerebral ischemia/reperfusion injury, dementia, hyperglycemia, and myocardial infarction. Our previous study found that kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside had an obvious anti-inflammatory effect, and could significantly improve the cell survival rate of H9c2 myocardium inflammatory injury induced by LPS. In this study, kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside significantly improved cardiac function, alleviated cardiac pathological changes, reduced the excessive deposition of myocardial interstitial collagen, and inhibited cardiomyocyte apoptosis in AMI rats. Furthermore, kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside could decrease the IL-1beta level and inhibit the expressions of NF-kappaB p65, NLRP3, ASC, Caspase-1, GSDMD and IL-1beta, suggesting that kaempferol-3-O-rutinoside could regulate NF-kappaB/NLRP3/Caspase-1 signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 急性心肌梗死（AMI）后的心室重构（VR）是慢性心力衰竭（CHF）的主要发病机制。山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷（KR）是六安瓜片茶中含量最高的黄酮苷类化合物，具有良好的药理活性。然而，KR抗AMI后VR的机制尚不清楚。采用分子对接预测KR在NLRP3/Caspase-1信号通路上的靶点。通过HE染色、Masson染色观察心肌组织学变化。使用TUNEL检测心肌细胞凋亡。采用免疫组织化学检测NLRP3、Caspase-1 p20和GSDMD。使用ELISA检测血清中IL-1β水平。最后，通过RT-PCR和Western blotting检测NF-κB p65、NLRP3、ASC、Caspase-1 p20、GSDMD和IL-1β的表达。我们的结果表明，KR与NLRP3、Caspase-1和GSDMD具有良好的结合活性，显著改善AMI大鼠的心脏功能，减轻心脏病理变化，减少心肌间质胶原的过度沉积，并抑制心肌细胞凋亡。此外，KR可降低IL-1β水平，并抑制NF-κB p65、NLRP3、ASC、Caspase-1 p20、GSDMD和IL-1β的表达。我们的研究表明，KR可预防和治疗AMI后的VR，其保护作用与其调节NF-κB/NLRP3/Caspase-1信号通路有关。实际应用：山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷存在于红花、白睡莲、Afgekia mahidoliae和绿茶中，对肝损伤、脑缺血/再灌注损伤、痴呆、高血糖和心肌梗死具有良好的药理活性。我们先前的研究发现，山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷具有明显的抗炎作用，并能显著提高LPS诱导的H9c2心肌炎症损伤的细胞存活率。在本研究中，山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷显著改善AMI大鼠的心脏功能，减轻心脏病理变化，减少心肌间质胶原的过度沉积，并抑制心肌细胞凋亡。此外，山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷可降低IL-1β水平，并抑制NF-κB p65、NLRP3、ASC、Caspase-1、GSDMD和IL-1β的表达，表明山柰酚-3-O-芸香糖苷可调节NF-κB/NLRP3/Caspase-1信号通路。
